name: CurlShot MCP
description: Hosted remote MCP server (streamable HTTP at https://curlshot.com/api/mcp) that lets AI agents take screenshots of public web pages as PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF or a scrolling video. Tools: take_screenshot and list_devices. Free plan with 100 screenshots a month.

env_keys.description: CurlShot API key, sent as Authorization: Bearer header by the MCP client
